query: INSERT INTO device_marketplace_session (org_id, device_id, marketplace, account_label, linked_at, last_used_at, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (org_id, device_id, marketplace) DO UPDATE SET account_label = EXCLUDED.account_label, status = EXCLUDED.status, last_used_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'connected' THEN EXCLUDED.last_used_at ELSE device_marketplace_session.last_used_at END
